data.narrative:
Nitricity is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $102.8M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable, all operating in the robotics and manufacturing sector at similar stages of development.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression approach uses total capital raised as a proxy baseline ($103M) and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B advancement, yielding $195M. The peer-median method examines three same-sector, same-stage private companies—Generalist AI ($2.0B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B), and Dexterity ($1.6B)—producing a median valuation of $1.8B and a range spanning $1.6B to $2.0B. These methods imply valuations that diverge substantially, reflecting uncertainty in whether Nitricity should be valued primarily on capital deployed or relative to later-stage peers achieving billion-dollar markings.

The triangulated analysis yields a range of $166M (low) to $2.0B (high), with a median of $973M. This wide spread reflects the material gap between bottom-up capital-based valuation and peer-relative benchmarking. Key uncertainties include revenue traction not visible in the provided data, margin profile relative to peers, and whether the three peer comps represent the appropriate reference set for Nitricity's specific robotics application and market position.
